result.topic_en: Calculations of definite integrals of trigonometric and exponential functions of $\rho - 1/\rho$ and $\rho + 1/\rho$ with respect to $\log\rho$, used to solve the hyperbolic equation $\partial^2 u/\partial p\partial q + u = 0$ by a Green-type integral identity.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^\infty \frac{\cos tx \sin x\, \partial x}{x}$ \quad $x = (\rho - \frac{1}{\rho})$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p \partial q} + u = 0$ \quad $\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial p\partial q} + u' = 0$
$\int \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p \partial q} u' \partial p \partial q = \int (u' \frac{\partial u}{\partial p} dp - u \frac{\partial u'}{\partial q} dq)$
$\int_0^\infty \cos(\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}) t\, \sin(\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}) \frac{\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}} \partial \log \rho$ \quad [-...-] $(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}) t$ \quad $\frac{\sin}{(\rho+\frac{1}{\rho})}$
$x + t > 0$ \quad $+u' \frac{\partial u}{\partial q} \partial q$
$\pm \frac{\partial u' u}{\partial q} dq$
$e^{(\rho - \frac{1}{\rho})t \pm (\rho + \frac{1}{\rho})x}$
$\int_0^\infty \sin(\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}) x \frac{\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}} \cos(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}) t\, \partial \log \rho$
$= \frac{1}{2} \int_0^\infty \left(\sin(\rho(x+t) - \frac{1}{\rho}(x-t)) + \sin(\rho(x-t) - \frac{1}{\rho}(x+t))\right) \frac{\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}} \partial \log \rho$
$= \frac{1}{2} \int_0^\infty \sin((\rho - \frac{1}{\rho})\sqrt{pq}) \left( \frac{q\rho + \frac{1}{\rho} p}{q\rho - \frac{1}{\rho} p} + \frac{p\rho + \frac{1}{\rho} q}{p\rho - \frac{1}{\rho} q} \right) \partial \log \rho$ \quad $x + t > 0$ \quad $x - t > 0$
$= \frac{1}{2} \int_0^\infty \sin((\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}) \sqrt{pq}) \frac{2pq(\rho^2 - \frac{1}{\rho^2})}{pq(\rho^2 + \frac{1}{\rho^2}) - p^2 - q^2} \frac{\partial(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho})}{(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho})} = \frac{1}{2}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \sin s \frac{2s\, \partial s}{s^2 - (p-q)^2}$
$\frac{2s\, \partial s}{s^2 - 4t^2} = \left(\frac{1}{s - 2t} + \frac{1}{s + 2t}\right) \partial s$
$\frac{1}{2} \int_{-\infty}^\infty \frac{\sin(s+2t) + \sin(s-2t)}{s} \partial s$
$2 \sin s \cos 2t$.
$\int_0^\infty \varepsilon\, e^{(\pm(\rho - \frac{1}{\rho})x + \varepsilon(\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}) \pm (\rho + \frac{1}{\rho})t)i} \frac{\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}} \partial \log \rho$ \quad $\frac{1}{8i}$
$\int_0^\infty \Sigma\, e^{\rho i (x\eta + \varepsilon + \vartheta t) + \frac{1}{\rho} i (-x\eta - \varepsilon + \vartheta t)} \cdot \frac{\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}} \partial \log \rho$
$\int_0^\infty e^{p\rho i + q \frac{1}{\rho} i} \frac{\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}} \partial \log \rho = \int_0^\infty e^{(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho}) i \sqrt{pq}} \frac{q\rho + p\frac{1}{\rho}}{q\rho - p\frac{1}{\rho}} \partial \log \rho$
$-i$ [-$\ast$-] $e^{q\rho i + p\frac{1}{\rho} i}$
$\frac{p\rho^3 + q\frac{1}{\rho}}{p\rho - q\frac{1}{\rho}}$
$\sigma^2 + pq$
$\frac{p+q}{2}$
$x > 0$
$pq\rho^2 + p^2 - q^2 - qp\frac{1}{\rho^2}$
$= \frac{2(p^2 - q^2)}{pq(\rho^2 + \frac{1}{\rho^2}) - p^2 - q^2} \partial \log \rho = \frac{2(p^2 - q^2)}{pq(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho})^2 - (p+q)^2} \frac{\partial(\rho + \frac{1}{\rho})}{\rho - \frac{1}{\rho}}$
[-$2(\ldots)$-]
$8i \int$ [-...-] $\frac{4(p^2 - q^2)}{\sigma^2 - (p+q)^2} \frac{\partial \sigma}{\sqrt{\sigma^2 - 4pq}}$ \quad $p + q = 2t$
$= \int_{-i\sqrt{pq}}^{+i\sqrt{pq}} e^{2\sigma} \frac{xt}{\sigma^2 + t^2} \frac{\partial \sigma}{\sqrt{\sigma^2 + pq}}$ \quad $2 \int_0^{\sqrt{pq}} \cos 2\sigma \frac{xt}{t^2 - \sigma^2} \frac{\partial \sigma}{\sqrt{pq - \sigma^2}}$

methods.what: Green-type integral identity for the hyperbolic equation u_pq + u = 0 with a second solution u'
methods.quote: $\int \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p \partial q} u' \partial p \partial q = \int (u' \frac{\partial u}{\partial p} dp - u \frac{\partial u'}{\partial q} dq)$

methods.what: Product-to-sum decomposition of sin·cos under the integral in terms of rho and 1/rho
Substitution s = (rho - 1/rho)sqrt(pq) reducing the integral to a rational times sine
Partial fraction decomposition followed by Dirichlet-integral evaluation
Combination of the two exponential kernel terms into a single rational function of rho^2 + 1/rho^2
Reduction to a finite integral over sigma with p+q=2t
